host: MacBook Pro (Mac17,2), Apple M5, 32 GB, macOS 27.0.1, Xcode 27.0 (27A266a)

method: See README.md. One app, one source, three Release builds (base / OuoSDK / sentry-cocoa); replay is a runtime switch on the same binary. Size: device build (generic/platform=iOS, arm64, unsigned then ad-hoc signed), .app bytes and IPA-shaped zip (deflate 9); deltas vs base. Init: DispatchTime around Ouo.start / SentrySDK.start in didFinishLaunching, main thread, 12 cold launches on fresh installs per variant. CPU/memory: proc_pid_rusage(RUSAGE_INFO_V6) every 0.5 s on the simulator app's host PID (user+system CPU, phys_footprint); idle window 5-20 s (memory 10-20 s), journey window 20-80 s, peak 0-85 s. Wire: local capture server answering 200 itself, request body bytes as sent (gzip) for every SDK request from launch to 100 s (85 s foreground, 15 s background), scaled to per minute. 3 journey rounds per variant (n=3, cut from the planned 6 for run time under host contention), interleaved and rotated. Timer-driven journey (no synthesised taps). Simulator numbers: host CPU and memory, loopback network. Host was heavily loaded (1-min load ~10-30 on 10 cores, a parallel Android emulator run); variants interleaved and rotated per round so both SDKs saw the same contention; host load average logged every 5 s and attached per run (load1). Runs: a first run under heavy host contention (load 10 to 500) was discarded and rerun on a quiet Mac (load about 2 to 3), 12 init launches and 3 journey rounds per variant.
